generate_gmock_classes: generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file by running gmock_class.py with the header path
generate_gmock_for_specific_class: generate a Google Mock class for a specific C++ class by passing its name as an argument
generate_gmock_all_classes: generate Google Mock classes for all classes in a C++ header file without specifying class names
review_GenerateMethods: review the _GenerateMethods function that creates MOCK_METHOD macro lines for each virtual method in a C++ class
review_GenerateMocks: review the _GenerateMocks function that iterates over AST nodes and generates Mock class definitions
